endpoints.description:
File Upload Overview
Uploading a file to your JobNimbus account is a 2 part process. You first have to get a Presigned URL that you can then use to PUT your file into the system. There are 2 endpoints to use depending on the size of the file to upload. If the file is <100MB, you should use the single part upload. If it is >100MB, you should use the multipart upload and upload the file in chunks.

Endpoint Overview
This is the endpoint used to get that presigned URL. It will only be valid for 15 minutes so make sure you do the PUT within that 15 minute timeout.

This endpoint is ideal for files under 100MB in size. For larger files, you may want to use the 'Create a File (Multipart)' endpoint.

When doing the PUT, include the file in the body of the request as a binary payload.

Within a few seconds of the PUT being completed, a thumbnail will be created if the file is an image or a PDF. If you want to get the URL of the thumbnail right away, you can call the /complete endpoint. This step is optional for a single part upload.

Request Method
POST

Request URL
http://api.jobnimbus.com/files/v1/uploads/url

Request Parameters

- isPrivate (bool): true if the file is private to the uploader

- related (Array of strings): an array of ids that this image is related to. Typically job ids, contact ids etc.

- type (int): One of the following values

1=Document

- 2=Photo

- 3=Email Attachment

- 4=naturalForms

- 5=Invoice

- 6=Eagleview

- 7=Accurence

- 8=Credit Memo

- XXX=Id of a custom type in the customers account

- filename (string): the name of the file including the extension

- description (string): an optional description of the file being uploaded

Response Codes:

- HTTP Status 200 = success

- Anything other status code = failure and will include an error message in the response

Response:

```
{    
    "data": 
    {        
        "url": "https://userdata-files-dev-us-west-2-jn.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/.....",        
        "jnid": "{ID OF THE FILE IN JOBNIMBUS}"    
    }
}
```

endpoints.description:
Endpoint Overview
This endpoint is used to complete the file upload process for a specific file identified by jnid. It allows you to finalize the upload and optionally generate a thumbnail for the uploaded file.

Request Method
POST

Request URL
https://api.jobnimbus.com/files/v1/uploads/:jnid/complete?generateThumbnail=true

Request Parameters

- Path Parameter:

jnid (string): The unique identifier for the file being uploaded.

- Query Parameter:

generateThumbnail (boolean): A flag indicating whether a thumbnail should be generated for the uploaded file. Set to true to generate a thumbnail.

Response Codes

- HTTP Status 200 = success

- Anything other status code = failure and will include an error message in the response

Expected Response

```
HTTP 200
{
    "data": {
        "jnid": "{ID of the file}",
        "thumbnailUrl": "{URL for the thumbnail}"
    }
}
```

Notes

- Ensure that the jnid is valid and corresponds to a file that was just upload through the 'Create a File' process

- The generateThumbnail parameter is optional; if not specified, the default behavior will be to not generate a thumbnail. If it is true, a url for the thumbnail will be returned in the response.

- Proper error handling should be implemented to manage cases where the upload fails or the job ID is invalid.

This endpoint is optional for completing file uploads. If you don't call this, the file will still be completed and a thumbnail will be created asynchronously.

Endpoint Overview
This endpoint allows users to upload multiple URLs to the JobNimbus API. It is designed to facilitate the management of file uploads by associating them with specific resources or entities within the JobNimbus system.

Request Method
POST

Request URL
https://api.jobnimbus.com/files/v1/uploads/multi-urls

Request Parameters

- partCount (number): The number of image parts that will be uploaded

- fileSize (number): The size in bytes of the original image

- isPrivate (boolean): Whether or not the image is private to the uploader

- related (Array of strings): A string array of JNIDs of related objects in the JobNimbus system. Typically jobs or contacts.

- type (number): One of the following values

1=Document

- 2=Photo

- 3=Email Attachment

- 4=naturalForms

- 5=Invoice

- 6=Eagleview

- 7=Accurence

- 8=Credit Memo

- XXX=Id of a custom type in the customers account

- filename (string): the name of the file including the extension

- description (string): an optional description of the file being uploaded

Response Codes

- HTTP Status 200 = success

- Anything other status code = failure and will include an error message in the response

Example Request Body

```
{
  "partCount": 3,
  "fileSize": 100000000,
  "isPrivate": false,
  "related": [
    "{JobNimbus Job ID}"
  ],
  "type": 2,
  "filename": "myphoto.jpg",
  "description": "a picure of a roof"
}
```

Response Structure
If successful, this will return an array of presigned urls. One url for each part needing to be uploaded. You will need to split your file into that many parts and upload each part to the appropriate url in the array.

```
{
    "data": {
        "presignedUrls": [
            "https://userdata-files-dev-us-west-2-jn.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/...",
            "https://userdata-files-dev-us-west-2-jn.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/...",
            "https://userdata-files-dev-us-west-2-jn.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/..."
        ],
        "jnid": "{the ID of the file uploaded}",
        "uploadId": "pcbG7KkXP8tJJ5DyvYyU3G3bqOKY_0lRNZkK6CKgx3MFQeKaEgzoJsusKwR6cO.SKXoJLbmOqlyLc3cPy99yqYFbmfK.RW_3SgsdDJ1LpeHIGK2FMPTqomAOMQwGzhdrF9aH9xiTlvrTRKHQNs0ceVixmwsZ9NqZXMBkvdlnn1c-"
    }
}
```
